_comment: Electron drift-time map for the 55Fe MC (run with: tgc_sim --drift-map). DriftLineRKF integrates one drift line per source grid point and returns mean_drift_ns (tau_bar) and rms_drift_ns (sigma_tau, from the integrated LONGITUDINAL diffusion) at continuous resolution, analytically and in seconds (no avalanche, no ions, no 0.5 ns argmax binning). ion drift OFF and amplifier OFF (electrons only). Geometry/gas are byte-identical to scan_gain.json / default_tgc.json so the committed .gas table is reused (no Magboltz regeneration). The source grid matches scan_gain.json / scan_waveform.json so the map aligns cell-for-cell with the gain and shape scans. n_events is IGNORED in --drift-map mode (RKF uses one line per cell). CAVEATS: rms_drift_ns is longitudinal diffusion only and under-counts the transverse/which-wire spread toward the inter-wire mid-plane (where the microscopic avalanche map is more complete); cells on the exact symmetry plane ride the field saddle, are flagged reached_wire=0 and written NaN. Investigation note: a faithful continuous sigma_tau was found NOT to change the 55Fe amplitude resolution (de-quantizing moved it 33.7%->34.1%), so this map is a diagnostic/utility, not a fix for the amplitude.
